title: PH's Red Spiegelman ends Miss International Queen 2026 bid in Top 6
summary: Red Spiegelman ended her Miss International Queen 2026 campaign in the Top 6 during the pageant’s coronation night on Saturday, September 19, in Pattaya, Thailand.
